name: Venezuela (1830–1836)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of yellow, blue and red, with an oval seal inscribed 'Estado de Venezuela' in the centre.
history: Flag of the State of Venezuela after its separation from Gran Colombia in 1830, keeping the Gran Colombian tricolour of equal stripes and adding the new state seal in the centre. In 1836 the seal was replaced by the coat of arms placed in the upper hoist.

features.role: seal of the State of Venezuela
